import heapq
from typing import Optional


class Helpdesk:
    PRIORITIES = ("normal", "high", "critical")

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.customers: dict[str, bool] = {}  # customer_name -> is_vip
        self._ticket_counter = 0
        self._tickets: dict[int, dict] = {}  # ticket_id -> metadata
        # Min-heap items: (vip_rank, prio_rank, ticket_id)
        # Lower value = higher priority
        self._queue: list[tuple[int, int, int]] = []
        self._in_queue: set[int] = set()

    def add_customer(self, name: str, vip: bool = False) -> None:
        self.customers[name] = vip

    def open_ticket(
        self,
        customer: str,
        title: str,
        priority: str = "normal",
        description: str = "",
    ) -> int:
        """Open a ticket; returns its id."""
        if not title:
            raise ValueError("Ticket title cannot be empty.")
        if priority not in self.PRIORITIES:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid priority: {priority}")

        self._ticket_counter += 1
        ticket_id = self._ticket_counter

        is_vip = self.customers.get(customer, False)
        # Priority mapping: critical -> 0, high -> 1, normal -> 2
        prio_rank = len(self.PRIORITIES) - 1 - self.PRIORITIES.index(priority)
        vip_rank = 0 if is_vip else 1

        self._tickets[ticket_id] = {
            "customer": customer,
            "title": title,
            "priority": priority,
            "description": description,
            "vip_rank": vip_rank,
            "prio_rank": prio_rank,
            "status": "queued",  # 'queued', 'in_progress', 'closed'
        }

        # Ticket id is strictly increasing, guaranteeing FIFO for identical priority & VIP status
        heapq.heappush(self._queue, (vip_rank, prio_rank, ticket_id))
        self._in_queue.add(ticket_id)
        return ticket_id

    def ticket(self, ticket_id: int) -> dict:
        """Return the ticket's data."""
        if ticket_id not in self._tickets:
            raise ValueError(f"Ticket {ticket_id} does not exist.")
        return self._tickets[ticket_id]

    def next_ticket(self) -> Optional[int]:
        """Take the ticket that should be handled next out of the queue; None if the queue is empty."""
        while self._queue:
            _, _, ticket_id = heapq.heappop(self._queue)
            if ticket_id in self._in_queue:
                self._in_queue.remove(ticket_id)
                self._tickets[ticket_id]["status"] = "in_progress"
                return ticket_id
        return None

    def close(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        if ticket_id not in self._tickets:
            raise ValueError(f"Ticket {ticket_id} does not exist.")
        self._tickets[ticket_id]["status"] = "closed"
        self._in_queue.discard(ticket_id)

    def reopen(self, ticket_id: int) -> None:
        """Put a ticket back into the queue."""
        if ticket_id not in self._tickets:
            raise ValueError(f"Ticket {ticket_id} does not exist.")
        ticket = self._tickets[ticket_id]
        if ticket["status"] == "closed":
            raise ValueError("A closed ticket cannot be reopened.")
        if ticket["status"] == "queued":
            return  # Already in queue

        ticket["status"] = "queued"
        self._in_queue.add(ticket_id)
        heapq.heappush(self._queue, (ticket["vip_rank"], ticket["prio_rank"], ticket_id))

    def queue_length(self) -> int:
        """Return the number of tickets waiting in the queue."""
        return len(self._in_queue)
```
